provenance: Golden vectors pinning the openQA HMAC-SHA1 signing wire format, derived from openQA e72ffeb28b6f77bde9bfcb96f490dd3d7049bf6d (OpenQA::UserAgent::_path_query and the server-side OpenQA::Shared::Controller::Auth::_valid_hmac), computed at a fixed timestamp per vector with an independent HMAC-SHA1 implementation (Python hmac/hashlib), not ruoqa. Case 1 is a known-value HMAC used as a control. Case 2 exercises the %20->+ rewrite scoped to the query, with a literal ~ preserved unchanged. Case 3 pins that the %20->+ rewrite does not apply to the path.
